extracted.intended_audience: MSU community, survivors, media, and the public
extracted.subtask_description: A compilation of university news statements, actions, and commitments related to the Larry Nassar matter, intended to inform the community about institutional responses, policy changes, investigations, and survivor support measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apology to survivors
rubrics_metrics.description: Acting President Satish Udpa delivered an apology to the survivors in which he acknowledged we were too slow to grasp the enormity of the offenses and failed to treat them with the care and respect they deserved.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Public, formal apologies acknowledging institutional failure and recognizing survivors' suffering; used as part of accountability and healing messaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to act more thoughtfully and create a safer campus
rubrics_metrics.description: The university is committed to acting more thoughtfully and working with our community to create solutions for a safer, more secure and more supportive university.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-level institutional commitment language signaling ongoing reform efforts and collaboration with community stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions about attorney-client privilege (waive vs. maintain)
rubrics_metrics.description: MSU Board of Trustees authorized the administration to begin the process of sharing privileged documents related to the attorney general’s investigation (Dec. 15, 2023); earlier the Board notified the Attorney General that it would not be taking action to waive attorney-client privilege (March 26, 2021).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Public statements should explain Board decisions on privilege, reference requests from authorities, and note any changes in position or actions taken to share privileged materials when authorized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eradicating relationship violence and sexual misconduct (RVSM) as a priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Eradicating RVSM remains key priority for MSU; build a climate that is safe, inclusive and vigilant in preventing sexual misconduct, protects survivors and is inclusive of all people.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Articulate prevention and culture-change goals as core institutional priorities in communications and policy planning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Completing tasks required by federal review
rubrics_metrics.description: Michigan State University has completed 33 tasks required through a review by the U.S. Department of Education’s Office for Civil Rights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use quantitative metrics (number of tasks completed) to report compliance with external reviews; provide specifics where possible and link to progress tracking tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expanding healing fund to cover additional mental health care costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Based on feedback from the survivor community and recommendations from the MSU Relationship Violence and Sexual Misconduct Expert Advisory Workgroup, the MSU Board of Trustees has expanded the medical services eligible for reimbursement under the Counseling and Mental Health Services Fund.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe changes to survivor support funds, explicitly tie expansions to survivor feedback and expert recommendations, and list eligible services or coverage changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establishing Counseling and Mental Health Services Fund to assist survivors
rubrics_metrics.description: The Board of Trustees announced the creation of the Counseling and Mental Health Services Fund as well as their intention to initiate an independent investigation into the facts associated with the Nassar case.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publicize creation of dedicated financial support mechanisms for counseling and mental health services and explain scope and administration of the fund.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creating an interim healing fund while details are developed
rubrics_metrics.description: While the details of the new fund are being developed, the university established an intermediate fund to support survivors' counseling and mental health services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communicate interim measures taken to provide immediate support while longer-term processes are established.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selecting national organizations to oversee Healing Assistance Fund
rubrics_metrics.description: Michigan State University selected the Commonwealth Mediation and Conciliation Inc. (CMCI) and the Minnesota Coalition Against Sexual Assault (MNCASA) to help facilitate access to counseling and mental health services for victims under the MSU Healing Assistance Fund.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Announce use of external, reputable organizations to administer survivor support to increase trust and independence; name selected organizations and their roles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appointing advisers on sexual misconduct issues reporting directly to the president
rubrics_metrics.description: Rebecca Campbell and Andrea Munford will report directly to the president to provide guidance and make strategic recommendations on sexual misconduct issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communicate the appointment of expert advisers, their reporting lines, and the scope of their advisory responsibilities to demonstrate action and accountability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementing trauma-informed, victim-centered investigative approaches
rubrics_metrics.description: New police initiative focuses on trauma-informed investigative support services; Lt. Andrea Munford assigned to develop a comprehensive program on law enforcement investigations into relationship violence and sexual assault on a trauma-informed and victim-centered basis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publicize adoption of trauma-informed, victim-centered practices in investigations and law enforcement training; identify responsible officers or units.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cooperating fully with external investigations and sharing facts
rubrics_metrics.description: MSU has cooperated fully with the Attorney General’s inquiry, including handing over all facts associated with the case.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State cooperation with law enforcement and oversight bodies and describe the extent of information shared to convey transparency and compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limiting public comment during active legal cases
rubrics_metrics.description: It is not appropriate to comment on the status or charges against an individual as this is an active legal case.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communications should avoid commenting on active prosecutions or pending charges and explain the reason for restraint when relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tracking and publicly reporting progress on actions addressing federal reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: A 'Track Our Progress' link provides a visual overview of what actions have been implemented, what is in progress and what actions the university still needs to take.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use publicly accessible tracking dashboards or visual overviews to report ongoing reforms, status updates, and outstanding items to stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiating independent investigations into institutional facts
rubrics_metrics.description: Board announced their intention to initiate an independent investigation into the facts associated with the Nassar case and discussed engagement scope for outside counsel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communicate plans for independent reviews, note scope and status, and explain governance decisions when engagements are delayed or disputed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Holding administrators accountable through personnel actions
rubrics_metrics.description: Actions included accepting resignations (e.g., William Strampel retired under agreement) and accepting provocations to pursue revocation of tenure and other personnel measures following reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Announce personnel changes and accountability steps taken in response to findings, while clarifying procedural actions (retirement agreements, tenure processes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Pursuing legal remedies (e.g., suing insurers) when appropriate
rubrics_metrics.description: MSU announced suits against insurance carriers for failing to honor their policies related to the Nassar matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose institutional legal actions taken to protect university interests or address failures by third parties; provide rationale and status where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigating suspected fraudulent claims against survivor funds
rubrics_metrics.description: It was brought to MSU's attention that there are possible fraudulent claims being made against the Healing Assistance Fund; the university allowed the MSU Police Department time to complete a thorough investigation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report concerns about fund integrity, explain investigatory steps, and balance accountability with commitment to timely survivor support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preserving community memorials and honoring survivors' expressions
rubrics_metrics.description: Survivors, parents and MSU community members joined curators from MSU Museum to begin preserving the more than 200 teal mesh bows wrapped around trees across campus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include actions to preserve community memorials or symbols related to survivor expression as part of restorative and commemorative efforts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adopting external oversight recommendations to enhance protections
rubrics_metrics.description: Agreed-upon revisions recommended by the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, Office for Civil Rights further enhance protections and policy improvements MSU has made since Nassar’s arrest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acknowledge and implement recommended revisions from external oversight bodies and communicate how they strengthen protections and policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publicly reporting major legal milestones and settlements
rubrics_metrics.description: MSU and Nassar survivors agreed in principle to a global settlement totaling $500 million; the university announced completion of the university’s financial transfer into a court-created settlement fund.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide timely statements about settlements, sentencing, convictions, and other case milestones; explain implications for survivors and institutional obligations.
